```{r}
gcd2 <- function(a, b) {
  if (b == 0) a else Recall(b, a %% b)
}
gcd <- function(...) Reduce(gcd2, c(...))
pn = function(coeffs,pows){
    pows = pows[coeffs!=0]
    coeffs = coeffs[coeffs!=0]
    ex1 = paste0("{",coeffs,"}x^{",pows,"}",collapse="+")
    ex1 = gsub("+{-","-{",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("{1}x^{0}","1",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("{-1}x^{0}","-1",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("{1}x","x",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("{-1}x","-x",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("x^{0}","",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("x^{1}","x",ex1,fixed=T)
    ex1 = gsub("+-","-",ex1,fixed=T)
    if(ex1 == ""){
        ex1 = "0"
    }
    return(ex1)
}

cn = function(a,b){
  cn = gsub("+-","-",paste0(a,"+",b,"i"),fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("0+0i","0",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("+1i","+i",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("-1i","-i",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("+0i","",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("-0i","",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  if(nchar(cn)>1 && substr(cn, start = 1, stop = 2)=="0+"){cn = gsub("0+","",cn,fixed=TRUE)}
  if(nchar(cn)>1 && substr(cn, start = 1, stop = 2)=="0-"){cn = gsub("0-","-",cn,fixed=TRUE)}
  return(cn)
}
```

```{r,echo=F}
psfs = rev((2:30)^2)

# a*sqrt(b)/(c*sqrt(d))
# a*sqrt(b*d)/(c*d)
# A*sqrt(R)/(D)

ex1s = c("\\frac{2\\sqrt{3}}{7\\sqrt{10}}","\\frac{1}{\\sqrt{3}}","\\frac{5\\sqrt{2}}{2\\sqrt{5}}","\\frac{4\\sqrt{3}}{\\sqrt{2}}")
ans1s = c("\\frac{\\sqrt{30}}{35}","\\frac{\\sqrt{3}}{3}","\\frac{\\sqrt{10}}{2}","2\\sqrt{6}")


while(length(ex1s)<14){
    while(T){
        canpass = T
        a = sample(1:10,1)
        b = sample(c(1,2,3,5,6,7,10),1)
        c = sample(1:10,1)
        d = sample(c(2,3,5,6,7,10),1)
        if(gcd(c(a,c))>1 || b==d){
            canpass = F
        }
        ex1 = paste0("\\frac{[",a,"]\\sqrt{",b,"}}{[",c,"]\\sqrt{",d,"}}")
        ex1 = gsub("[1]\\sqrt{1}","1",ex1,fixed=T)
        ex1 = gsub("[1]","",ex1,fixed=T)
        ex1 = gsub("[","",ex1,fixed=T)
        ex1 = gsub("]","",ex1,fixed=T)
        ex1 = gsub("\\sqrt{1}","",ex1,fixed=T)
        A1 = a
        R1 = b*d
        D1 = c*d
        A2 = A1
        R2 = R1
        D2 = D1
        for(psf in psfs){
            if(R2%%psf==0){
                A2 = round(A1*sqrt(psf))
                R2 = round(R1/psf)
            }
        }
        gg = gcd(c(A2,D2))
        A3 = round(A2/gg)
        D3 = round(D2/gg)
        if(D3>1){
            ans1 = paste0("\\frac{[",A3,"]\\sqrt{",R2,"}}{",D3,"}")
        } else {
            ans1 = paste0("[",A3,"]\\sqrt{",R2,"}")
        }
        ans1 = gsub("[1]\\sqrt{1}","1",ans1,fixed=T)
        ans1 = gsub("[1]","",ans1,fixed=T)
        ans1 = gsub("[","",ans1,fixed=T)
        ans1 = gsub("]","",ans1,fixed=T)
        ans1 = gsub("\\sqrt{1}","",ans1,fixed=T)
        if(canpass){break}
    }
    if(!(ex1 %in% ex1s)){
        ex1s = c(ex1s,ex1)
        ans1s = c(ans1s,ans1)
    }
}

```



### Rationalize denominator with single term


```{r,echo=F,results='asis'}
for(i in 1:length(ex1s)){
    cat("\\begin{minipage}[t][1.8in]{0.5\\textwidth}")
    cat(paste0(i,". Simplify (and rationalize denominator): $$",ex1s[i],"$$ \n"))
    cat("\\end{minipage}")
    if(i%%2==0){
        cat("\n\n\\vfill\n\n")
    }
}
cat("\n\n")
cat(paste0("$",ans1s,"$",collapse=" \\hfill "))
```
